old: - **Vagabond cost and reuse:** The pawn **may activate repeatedly in a turn**. For each icon, exhaust **one face-up, undamaged hammer**, and the pawn's **current clearing must match every icon on the card**. Reusing the pawn never waives the hammer payment per icon. new: - **Vagabond cost and reuse:** The pawn **may activate repeatedly in a turn**. For each icon, **pay by exhausting one face-up, undamaged hammer: flip that hammer face down**. The pawn's **current clearing must match every icon on the card**. Reusing the pawn never waives the hammer payment per icon. One clearing cannot pay mixed fox/rabbit/mouse icons.
